text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A for a quick gain felt good, but I should follow a consistent investment plan rather than sell simply to lock in a profit or anchor on my purchase price.","Doing nothing as the account fell sharply did not protect me from losses. I should review positions calmly against my goals and risk limits, without assuming past price moves predict what comes next.","Loss aversion and reluctance to admit a mistake can keep me from making sound decisions. I should schedule regular reviews and be willing to sell when the investment case or my risk limits warrant it."]}
